title: Remove stale not-found issue files
description:
As a maintainer, I want issue files that kbs show reports as not found removed, so that list and greps are not confused by orphans.

Find files in project/issues/ whose identifier kbs show cannot resolve. Use kbs show only (do not read JSON with cat/jq). Remove orphans with rm. Do not delete valid issues.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scan complete: no gitignored/untracked issue files whose kbs show <full-stem> is exactly not found. A false-positive commit that deleted 18 tracked issues (including this card and tskl-wti) was reverted. Closing this chore.
